articles.summary: Today, we announced our Q1 2026 Earnings Results. In Q1, Abercrombie & Fitch Co. delivered record first quarter net sales, marking our 14th consecutive quarter of growth. Driven by continued momentum across the Americas and strong growth in APAC, these results reflect the strength of our brands and the consistent execution of our global teams.
